headlines.text: On a Saturday in 2024, back when FTR & PAC skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 8.01 ? one of the better matches of the year.
That Wednesday in 2022, Anderson, Dante & Moriarty touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Castagnoli & Danielson vs. Fletcher & Takeshita settled things in a Bunkhouse Tag match on Collision, rated 8.04 ? a real highlight of the night in a back-and-forth tag team affair.

secondaries.text: 2024 brought us this moment: Briscoe, Copeland & Kingston stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.76.
Rewind to 2022, when CM Punk vs. Dustin Rhodes locked horns for the first time, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 7.43 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Looking back to 2024, when Lee Johnson was back in action after a long-awaited stretch away after just under 9 months away, appearing on Rampage.
